verdict.rationale: Pricing is a fair axis for a hosted MCP platform, but the evidence never documents a free tier for prototyping tool connections. The only pricing references are to 'included credits' with metered overage spend limits (manufact-docs-20) and community confusion about the credit system (manufact-comm-1); neither establishes a no-cost plan. A sign-in-free readiness scan is an adjacent feature, not a free tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything
